what_it_does: When engineers debug stability problems on smartphones, they rely on tracing tools that record a log of events happening inside the operating system. Most existing tracers store events in separate per-processor buffers to keep performance overhead low, but this design can silently drop events or record them out of order — exactly the clues needed to diagnose crashes. BTrace is a tracing system designed specifically for smartphones that rethinks how those buffers are managed so that important events are not lost, while still keeping the overhead acceptable for a device that users are actively using. The details of the buffer coordination strategy are hedged here since only the abstract was available, but the core innovation is prioritizing completeness over raw speed for the smartphone context.
